from.place: Proof steps 2--4: ordinary scalar tensor comparison, K-flat preservation, and descent through good-complex localizations.

title: Core normalized scalar-extension data for one finite completed tensor model
statement: For the data in lem-sf-adic-completed-tensor-finite-model and a fixed ConstructibleTensorCompletionPresentation completion, there exists a CompletedTensorFiniteModelCore l X R closed models E completion carrying the balanced scalar comparison, pure-section normalization, K-flat preservation, ordinary derived comparison, and representative counit equation. The completion presentation itself is not part of this core.

source.place: Definition 3.4.10 and Lemma 6.5.5; the scalar-extension and K-flat descent portion of the finite-model construction.

proof.text: Specialize pbc_tensor_balance_exists to coefficientMap l X R E. The source total tensor is the published constructibleTensorTotal by definition, and its generator is constructibleTensorTotalSection, so the comparison and its pure-section formula are balance and balance_sections.

Apply independent-coefficient changeOfRings_isKFlat_independentCoefficients to coefficientMap and the published object/map equations for pbcExtend. Good integral complexes are K-flat, so their scalar extensions are K-flat. The scalar counit is invertible on each good complex and on its total tensor, using coefficientTotalTensor_isKFlat.

The product of the good-complex localizations gives fully faithful restriction of derived bifunctors. Apply tensorComparisonDescent with completion.model, models.comparison, the natural scalar counit, and balance. Its defining component equation is tensorFiniteRepresentative. Package the resulting ordinary comparison, balance, section equation, K-flat proofs, and representative equation in CompletedTensorFiniteModelCore.

proof_origin.place: Definition 3.4.10 and Lemma 6.5.5, with Stacks 03EL, 07A4 and 0G7E. Proved normalized scalar total comparison, K-flat preservation, and two-variable representative descent; no additional theorem holes.

theorem completed_tensor_finite_model_core
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (R : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l X)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    (closed : CoefficientClosedStructure (ambientHom l X R))
    (models : CoefficientTensorModels.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed)
    (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (completion : ConstructibleTensorCompletionPresentation l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X) :
    Nonempty (CompletedTensorFiniteModelCore l X R closed models E completion)
